tasks.title: Implement prohibitionMatch field shape
tasks.description: null when no match; {ruleId, ruleName, highConfidence} when matched. ruleName from rule's primaryName. highConfidence is entity.score >= threshold.

tasks.title: Read threshold from app config
tasks.description: App config key docudesk.prohibition.high_confidence_threshold (default 0.85). Use existing IAppConfig pattern consistent with EntityDetectionService.

tasks.description: GET /api/anonymization/batch/{batchId}/entities calls matchProhibition for each consolidated entity. Use highestConfidence for the threshold check.

tasks.title: Resolve dossier bases for suggestedBases
tasks.description: Read each batch file's dossier bases[] and union them, deduplicated. Attach suggestedBases per entity.

tasks.title: Handle multi-dossier and orphan files
tasks.description: Multi-dossier: union of bases. Orphan files or empty-bases dossiers: suggestedBases is [].

tasks.title: Unit test the suggestedBases resolver
tasks.description: Dossier-bound, orphan, multi-dossier, empty-dossier-bases.

tasks.title: Run gate before forwarding to OpenRegister
tasks.description: Resolve all detected entities for the file via EntityRelationMapper::findEntitiesForFile; call matchProhibition on each; collect (ruleId, entityId, confidence, ruleName, entityName).

tasks.title: Fail with 422 + missingProhibitionMatches body when high-confidence missing
tasks.description: For each high-confidence match, verify entity is in the to-be-anonymised set. If any missing, fail with HTTP 422 + {error, missingProhibitionMatches: [...]}.

tasks.title: Resolve canonical entity name for 422 body
tasks.description: entityName from OpenRegister Entity record's canonical name (NOT literal detected text, NOT rule's primaryName). Use EntityMapper::find($entityId) or equivalent OR helper.

tasks.title: Application logging on gate firing
tasks.description: Log ruleId, entityId, fileId on a 422 firing. Do NOT log the literal detected text.

tasks.title: Accept acknowledgedOverrides on anonymise payload
tasks.description: Optional top-level array. Each entry: {ruleId, entityId, reason?}.

tasks.title: Validate override against current extraction
tasks.description: Each override MUST correspond to an actual (ruleId, entityId) match. Match's confidence MUST be < threshold to release.

tasks.title: Reject override on high-confidence match
tasks.description: If override is for a >= threshold match: reject with 422 + body containing rejectedOverrides array alongside missingProhibitionMatches.

tasks.title: Silently ignore non-matching override
tasks.description: If an override doesn't correspond to any active match, silently ignore (do not error).

tasks.title: Unit test override validator
tasks.description: Valid release; rejected for high-confidence; ignored for non-matching; override array missing/empty.
